data.body: [P2] Reject an unavailable owner identity before acquiring AWS fences. On macOS or another host without this `/proc` file, deployment proceeds with `bootId=None`, but `same_owner_lock` subsequently rejects every recovery attempt. An interrupted update thus leaves persistent deployment fences that cleanup cannot reconcile even on the original host. Obtain a stable platform-specific boot identity, or raise `ProvisioningError` here before permitting deployment writes, and test the unavailable-boot-ID path.
